```{r}
# Target raptors for BBS analysis
raptor_bbs_raw <- c(
  "Red-tailed Hawk", "Red-shouldered Hawk", "Broad-winged Hawk",
  "Cooper's Hawk", "Sharp-shinned Hawk", "Northern Harrier",
  "Bald Eagle", "Osprey", "American Kestrel",
  "Peregrine Falcon", "Turkey Vulture", "Black Vulture",
  "Great Horned Owl", "Barred Owl", "Eastern Screech-Owl",
  "American Barn Owl", "Short-eared Owl"
)

# Match each species against BBS taxonomy
verified_species <- data.frame(
  search_term  = character(),
  bbs_name     = character(),
  aou          = numeric(), #unique species identifcation number 
  combine_flag = logical(),
  match_type   = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
failed_species <- character() #species which are not matched

for (sp in raptor_bbs_raw) {
  search_term <- gsub("^American ", "", sp)
  search_term <- gsub(" \\(.*\\)", "", search_term) #this improves matching success with bbs taxonomy

  results <- tryCatch(
    search_species(search_term),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(results) || nrow(results) == 0) {
    failed_species <- c(failed_species, sp)
    next
  }

  all_forms_row <- results %>% filter(grepl("all forms", english))
  exact_row     <- results %>% filter(english == sp)

  if (nrow(all_forms_row) > 0) {
    verified_species <- bind_rows(verified_species, data.frame(
      search_term  = sp,
      bbs_name     = all_forms_row$english[1],
      aou          = all_forms_row$aou[1],
      combine_flag = TRUE,
      match_type   = "all_forms"
    ))
  } else if (nrow(exact_row) == 1) {
    verified_species <- bind_rows(verified_species, data.frame(
      search_term  = sp,
      bbs_name     = exact_row$english[1],
      aou          = exact_row$aou[1],
      combine_flag = FALSE,
      match_type   = "exact"
    ))
  } else {
    failed_species <- c(failed_species, sp)
  }
}

# Save verified species table
write.csv(verified_species, "data/bbs_verified_species.csv", row.names = FALSE)

print(verified_species)
```

```{r}
# Thresholds for modelable species
MIN_ROUTES     <- 5
MIN_YEARS      <- 10
MIN_DETECTIONS <- 20

species_data_check <- data.frame(
  species          = character(),
  n_routes_ohio    = integer(),
  n_years_ohio     = integer(),
  total_det_ohio   = integer(),
  passes_threshold = logical(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(verified_species))) {
  sp           <- verified_species$bbs_name[i]
  combine_flag <- verified_species$combine_flag[i]

  tryCatch({
    bbs_sp <- stratify(by = "bbs_usgs", species = sp,
                       combine_species_forms = combine_flag)

    ohio_data   <- bbs_sp$birds_strata  %>% filter(state_num == 66, year >= 2000, year <= 2024)
    ohio_routes <- bbs_sp$routes_strata %>% filter(state_num == 66, year >= 2000, year <= 2024)

    n_routes  <- length(unique(paste(ohio_routes$state_num, ohio_routes$route)))
    n_years   <- length(unique(ohio_data$year))
    total_det <- sum(ohio_data$species_total, na.rm = TRUE)

    species_data_check <- bind_rows(species_data_check, data.frame(
      species          = sp,
      n_routes_ohio    = n_routes,
      n_years_ohio     = n_years,
      total_det_ohio   = total_det,
      passes_threshold = n_routes >= MIN_ROUTES & total_det >= MIN_DETECTIONS & n_years >= MIN_YEARS
    ))
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

# Split into modelable vs descriptive-only
modelable_species <- species_data_check %>% filter(passes_threshold)
descriptive_only  <- species_data_check %>% filter(!passes_threshold)

# Save full availability table
write.csv(species_data_check, "data/bbs_data_availability.csv", row.names = FALSE)

print(species_data_check)
```

```{r}
# Species that passed threshold and ready for modelling
species_to_model <- verified_species %>%
  filter(bbs_name %in% modelable_species$species)

# Convergence thresholds
RHAT_THRESHOLD <- 1.05
ESS_THRESHOLD  <- 400

convergence_log <- data.frame(
  species       = character(),
  model_variant = character(),
  max_rhat      = numeric(),
  min_ess_bulk  = numeric(),
  converged     = logical(),
  error_message = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(species_to_model))) {

  sp           <- species_to_model$bbs_name[i]
  combine_flag <- species_to_model$combine_flag[i]
  safe_name    <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", sp)
  checkpoint_file <- paste0("data/bbs_checkpoints/trend_", safe_name, ".rds")

  if (file.exists(checkpoint_file)) next #avoids rerunning models

  tryCatch({

    # Stratify continent-wide (required for hierarchical shrinkage)
    bbs_sp  <- stratify(by = "bbs_usgs", species = sp,
                        combine_species_forms = combine_flag)
    prepped <- prepare_data(bbs_sp,
                            min_year            = 2000,
                            max_year            = 2024,
                            min_n_routes        = 3,
                            min_max_route_years = 3)

    # Spatial preparation with hierarchical fallback
    model_variant_used <- "spatial"
    prepped_spatial <- tryCatch(
      prepare_spatial(prepped, strata_map = strata_map),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (!is.null(prepped_spatial)) {
      model_prepped <- prepare_model(prepped_spatial,
                                     model = "gamye", model_variant = "spatial")
    } else {
      model_prepped <- prepare_model(prepped,
                                     model = "gamye", model_variant = "hier")
      model_variant_used <- "hier"
    }

    # Fit model
    model_run <- run_model(model_prepped,
                           iter_warmup   = 1000,
                           iter_sampling = 1000,
                           chains        = 4,
                           save_model    = TRUE,
                           output_dir    = "data/bbs_models")

    # Convergence diagnostics
    conv     <- get_convergence(model_run)
    rhat_col <- intersect(c("r_hat", "rhat", "Rhat"), names(conv))[1]
    ess_col  <- intersect(c("ess_bulk", "ess"),        names(conv))[1]
    max_rhat <- max(conv[[rhat_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    min_ess  <- min(conv[[ess_col]],  na.rm = TRUE)

    convergence_log <<- bind_rows(convergence_log, data.frame(
      species       = sp,
      model_variant = model_variant_used,
      max_rhat      = round(max_rhat, 4),
      min_ess_bulk  = round(min_ess, 0),
      converged     = max_rhat <= RHAT_THRESHOLD & min_ess >= ESS_THRESHOLD,
      error_message = NA_character_
    ))

    # Generate indices at all region levels — posteriors aggregated correctly
    indices_all <- generate_indices(
      model_output = model_run,
      regions      = c("stratum", "prov_state", "continent")
    )

    # Trends for both periods
    trends_full  <- generate_trends(indices_all, min_year = 2000, max_year = 2024) #long term trend
    trends_short <- generate_trends(indices_all, min_year = 2014, max_year = 2024) #short term trend

    extract_trend_df <- function(tr) {
      if (is.list(tr) && "trends" %in% names(tr)) as.data.frame(tr$trends)
      else as.data.frame(tr)
    }

    # Filter to Ohio state row and Ohio strata
    ohio_filter <- function(df) {
      df %>% filter(
        (region_type == "prov_state" & region == "US-OH") |
        (region_type == "stratum"    & grepl("^US-OH", region))
      )
    }

    df_full_oh  <- ohio_filter(extract_trend_df(trends_full))  %>% mutate(period = "2000-2024")
    df_short_oh <- ohio_filter(extract_trend_df(trends_short)) %>% mutate(period = "2014-2024")

    final_trend_df <- bind_rows(df_full_oh, df_short_oh) %>%
      mutate(species = sp, model_variant = model_variant_used,
             converged = max_rhat <= RHAT_THRESHOLD & min_ess >= ESS_THRESHOLD,
             max_rhat = max_rhat, min_ess = min_ess)

    # Extract Ohio annual indices
    indices_df <- if (is.list(indices_all) && "indices" %in% names(indices_all))
      as.data.frame(indices_all$indices) else as.data.frame(indices_all)

    indices_ohio        <- indices_df %>% filter(region_type == "prov_state" & region == "US-OH")
    indices_ohio_strata <- indices_df %>% filter(region_type == "stratum" & grepl("^US-OH", region))

    # Save checkpoint
    saveRDS(
      list(
        trends              = final_trend_df,
        indices_ohio        = indices_ohio,
        indices_ohio_strata = indices_ohio_strata,
        convergence         = data.frame(max_rhat, min_ess,
                                         converged = max_rhat <= RHAT_THRESHOLD & min_ess >= ESS_THRESHOLD,
                                         variant   = model_variant_used)
      ),
      file = checkpoint_file
    )

    rm(model_run, bbs_sp, prepped, prepped_spatial, model_prepped,
       indices_all, indices_df, indices_ohio, indices_ohio_strata,
       trends_full, trends_short, df_full_oh, df_short_oh, final_trend_df, conv)

  }, error = function(e) {
    convergence_log <<- bind_rows(convergence_log, data.frame(
      species       = sp,
      model_variant = NA_character_,
      max_rhat      = NA_real_,
      min_ess_bulk  = NA_real_,
      converged     = FALSE,
      error_message = e$message
    ))
  })
}

# Save convergence log
write.csv(convergence_log, "data/bbs_convergence_log.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

  
```{r}
#Assemble Combined Results
# Load all checkpoint files
all_trends         <- list()
all_indices_ohio   <- list()
all_indices_strata <- list()

for (f in finished_files) {
  sp_data <- readRDS(file.path("data/bbs_checkpoints", f))
  sp_name <- sp_data$trends$species[1]
  if (is.null(sp_name) || is.na(sp_name)) next

  all_trends[[sp_name]] <- sp_data$trends

  if (!is.null(sp_data$indices_ohio) && nrow(sp_data$indices_ohio) > 0)
    all_indices_ohio[[sp_name]] <- sp_data$indices_ohio %>% mutate(species = sp_name)

  if (!is.null(sp_data$indices_ohio_strata) && nrow(sp_data$indices_ohio_strata) > 0)
    all_indices_strata[[sp_name]] <- sp_data$indices_ohio_strata %>% mutate(species = sp_name)
}

trend_summary <- bind_rows(all_trends)
```
 
```{r}
# Derive convergence flag if missing from checkpoint
if (!"converged" %in% names(trend_summary)) {
  trend_summary <- trend_summary %>%
    mutate(converged = if ("max_rhat" %in% names(.)) max_rhat < RHAT_THRESHOLD else NA)
}

# Significance and direction flags
trend_summary <- trend_summary %>%
  mutate(
    significant = sign(trend_q_0.025) == sign(trend_q_0.975),
    direction   = case_when(
      significant & trend > 0 ~ "Significant increase",
      significant & trend < 0 ~ "Significant decline",
      TRUE                    ~ "No significant change"
    )
  )

# Extract Ohio prov_state rows
ohio_trends <- trend_summary %>%
  filter(region_type == "prov_state" & region == "US-OH")

# Fallback: route-weighted average across Ohio strata if prov_state missing
if (nrow(ohio_trends) == 0) {
  ohio_trends <- trend_summary %>%
    filter(region_type == "stratum" & grepl("^US-OH", region)) %>%
    group_by(species, period) %>%
    summarise(
      trend          = weighted.mean(trend,          n_routes, na.rm = TRUE),
      trend_q_0.025  = weighted.mean(trend_q_0.025,  n_routes, na.rm = TRUE),
      trend_q_0.975  = weighted.mean(trend_q_0.975,  n_routes, na.rm = TRUE),
      percent_change = weighted.mean(percent_change,  n_routes, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_strata       = n(),
      total_routes   = sum(n_routes, na.rm = TRUE),
      converged      = all(converged, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      region_type = "ohio_weighted",
      region      = "US-OH",
      significant = sign(trend_q_0.025) == sign(trend_q_0.975),
      direction   = case_when(
        significant & trend > 0 ~ "Significant increase",
        significant & trend < 0 ~ "Significant decline",
        TRUE                    ~ "No significant change"
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
# load each species model, filter to Ohio strata, average across strata per year
all_indices <- lapply(ohio_raptors, function(sp) {
  obj <- readRDS(file.path(checkpoint_dir, file_map[sp]))
  idx <- obj$indices$indices

  idx %>%
    filter(grepl("^US-OH", region)) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(
      index = mean(index,         na.rm = TRUE),
      lci   = mean(index_q_0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      uci   = mean(index_q_0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(species = sp)
})

# stack all species into one long data frame
indices <- bind_rows(all_indices)
head(indices)
```

```{r}
#standardized every species to start at 1 
indices <- indices %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  mutate(
    base    = index[year == min(year)][1],
    index.s = index / base, #same as baseline year
    lci.s   = lci   / base, 
    uci.s   = uci   / base 
  ) %>%
  select(-base) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#Colors and end-year labels
sp_colours <- setNames(hue_pal()(length(ohio_raptors)), ohio_raptors)

endyr_df <- indices %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  filter(year == max(year)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    pct_change = round((index.s - 1) * 100, 0),
    label      = ifelse(pct_change >= 0,
                        paste0("+", pct_change, "%"),
                        paste0(pct_change, "%"))
  )
```

```{r fig-individual, fig.width=14, fig.height=12, dpi=300}

ohio_raptor_trends <- ggplot(indices, aes(x = year)) +
  geom_blank(data = data.frame(year = 2000, index.s = 1,
                                species = ohio_raptors),
             aes(y = index.s)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lci.s, ymax = uci.s, fill = species), alpha = 0.12) +
  geom_line(aes(y = index.s, colour = species), linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed",                   #baseline reference line
             colour = "black", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(data = endyr_df,
            aes(x = year, y = index.s, label = label, colour = species),
            hjust = 1.5, vjust = -1.2, size = 8, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = sp_colours) +                        #same color for line and ribbon
  scale_fill_manual(values = sp_colours) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2024, 5)) +
  ggh4x::facet_wrap2(~ species, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y", axes = "all") +
  labs(x = "Year (2000-2024)",
       y = "Relative abundance index",
       title = "Raptor population trends, 2000–2024") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "none",
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 15), #species name panel titles
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title       = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18, margin = margin(t = 10)),
  )

ohio_raptor_trends
```
